Metadata.summary: The first German production from the world's leading Internet TV Network is set in a present-day German town where the disappearance of two young children exposes the double lives and fractured relationships among four families. In 10 hour-long episodes, the story takes on a surprising twist that ties back to the same town in 1986.
Metadata.title: Dark

CommonSenseMedia.oneLiner: Eerie German series is violent and disturbing -- it's dark.
